title: Coherence of normalized mixed sections comparisons
statement: For arbitrary scheme morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y [def-pc-scheme] and every derived object F on their pullback [def-pc-derived-category], the normalized mixed global-sections comparisons [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso] commute with the conjugate under the pinned adjunctions [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] of the fixed derived pullback-composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Explicitly, writing δ for that conjugate, c_h for the Leray comparison, G_Z for derived global sections, S_h for scalar restriction and q:S_gX;S_f≅S_f′;S_g for the scalar-square comparison [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison], one has G_Y(δ_F);(c_g)_(Rf′_*F);S_g((c_f′)_F)=(c_f)_(RgX_*F);S_f((c_gX)_F);q_(G_X′F). No pullback units or base-change maps occur, and the sheaf and module localization universes are independent.

proof.text: Use derivedDirectImage_square_mate to identify the conjugate delta with the square composite of schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso.

Apply mixedSections_composition_coherence to each path. Functoriality and inverse cancellation remove the second composition comparison. Equality induction on pullback.condition moves the composite sections comparison across the transport. Expand schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso and cancel the first scalar comparison with its inverse.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction to direct-image mate normalization and one-path Leray composition, combined using functoriality, equality transport and inverse cancellation.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedSections_square_comparison_coherence
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (F : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback f g)) :
    let a := fun {A D : Scheme.{u}} (h : A ⟶ D) ↦ schemeHomPullbackAdjunction h
    let p := @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    let k := p (pullback.snd f g) g ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun h ↦ derivedPullback h)
        (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := g)).symm) ≪≫
          (p (pullback.fst f g) f).symm
    let δ := conjugateEquiv ((a f).comp (a (pullback.fst f g)))
      ((a g).comp (a (pullback.snd f g))) k.hom
    (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Y).map (δ.app F) ≫
        (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj F) ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
          ((mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.snd f g)).hom.app F) =
      (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
          ((mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (pullback.fst f g)).hom.app F) ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          pullback.condition).hom.app ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections (pullback f g)).obj F)
